scope: Prospective qualification matrix for the recovered candidate source. Historical tests and live local demonstrations are retained as history, not final-source PASS. The release-evidence reconciler may update narrowly scoped criteria only from the exact published archive and matching final receipts. Authenticated API, Pro, Codex and commercial authorization remain blocked.

criteria.requirement: Install, launch, run, export and reopen the browser core
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: node --test tests/*.test.cjs; graphical first-use test
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final 0.2.0 source and graphical evidence

criteria.requirement: Start the shipped Python connector from a clean extracted archive
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: python3 scripts/qualify_archive.py ARCHIVE --expected-sha256 SHA --expected-source-revision COMMIT --output NEW_DIR
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Exact committed archive

criteria.requirement: Authenticated frontier API inference
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Customer-authorized authenticated completion with provider/model identity and usage receipt
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Approved credentials and authority for separately billed inference; fixtures are not a live pass

criteria.requirement: Actual local LLM inference
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Real llama.cpp CPU model discovery, buffered completion and SSE completion without API credentials.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final-source receipt required. Linux llama.cpp with pinned SmolLM2-135M protocol checks and Qwen3-1.7B construction. Other local runtimes are contract-configurable, not separately live-qualified. Preserved factual/malformed-output failures limit quality claims.
criteria.historical_scope: Linux llama.cpp with pinned SmolLM2-135M protocol checks and Qwen3-1.7B construction. Other local runtimes are contract-configurable, not separately live-qualified. Preserved factual/malformed-output failures limit quality claims.

criteria.requirement: Eligible live ChatGPT Pro plan inference
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Official sign-in, model discovery, completed Responses stream, disconnect
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Eligible account consent and approved external authentication route; no password/cookie workaround

criteria.requirement: Paid-edition ChatGPT-plan authorization
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Record OpenAI authorization applicable to this commercial distribution
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: OpenAI commercial eligibility/partner approval; open-source eligibility is insufficient

criteria.requirement: Official Codex authenticated construction
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Current official Codex 0.167.0 and 0.169.0-alpha.7 schema/profile checks; credential-free native sandbox probe; independent authority/resume tests. Authenticated construction remains pending.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Eligible SIWC consent and an actual authenticated Codex construction receipt remain required. Credential-free native sandbox reports may describe only that host's isolation; they do not establish ChatGPT-plan access, completed model turns or commercial authorization.

criteria.requirement: Actual single-model and multi-agent orchestration
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Actual local Qwen3-1.7B single-builder (one inference call) and builder/critic (two distinct inference calls) completed frozen arithmetic construction.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final-source receipt required. Separate roles share one local model; multi-provider combinations are contract-tested. Narrow arithmetic task, not general reasoning or invention superiority.
criteria.historical_scope: Separate roles share one local model; multi-provider combinations are contract-tested. Narrow arithmetic task, not general reasoning or invention superiority.

criteria.requirement: Execute all seven bounded orchestration strategies
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Execute single model, actor/critic, research, economist, parallel exploration, adaptive routing and adversarial review through the real connector/workflow engine with explicit authored responses; inspect independent authority, allocation and retained-branch regressions.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final extracted-byte operation receipt required. This criterion covers executable policies with authored fixtures; live inference and any strategy advantage require separate evidence.

criteria.requirement: Construct and independently check a usable artifact
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Live local model constructed calculator.json; frozen checks passed; exported RUN_INSTRUMENT.py executed outside HARNESS and returned 34 for x=17.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final-source receipt required. Bounded arithmetic grammar. A useful executable construction, not arbitrary-code or open-world scientific validation.
criteria.historical_scope: Bounded arithmetic grammar. A useful executable construction, not arbitrary-code or open-world scientific validation.

criteria.requirement: Retain, reopen and reuse on a different successor
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Close/reopen integrity-protected state; inherit artifact onto distinct successor inputs; rerun frozen successor acceptance.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final-source receipt required. Finite numerical transfer only; current acceptance and authority are not inherited.
criteria.historical_scope: Finite numerical transfer only; current acceptance and authority are not inherited.

criteria.requirement: Measure successor advantage against competent ordinary reuse
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Compare retained execution against competent equal-content ordinary reuse, counting construction/verification/maintenance declarations.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final-source receipt required. Ordinary reuse ties. No successor performance or discovery advantage established; unknown economic costs remain unknown.
criteria.historical_scope: Ordinary reuse ties. No successor performance or discovery advantage established; unknown economic costs remain unknown.

criteria.requirement: Independent mechanism comparison and negative result preservation
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Independent evaluator and conventional comparator; preserve initial failed checks and negative/tied result.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final-source receipt required. Bounded computational mechanism; no general invention superiority or empirical economic validation.
criteria.historical_scope: Bounded computational mechanism; no general invention superiority or empirical economic validation.

criteria.requirement: Paired evidence-acquisition fixture with competent conventional control
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Execute bridge.strategy_demo from the exact archive; compare isolated no-retrieval and authorized-retrieval arms with equal declared budgets, preserved initial failures, withheld synthetic source bytes, honest abstention and a deterministic zero-model-call source reader.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final paired receipt required. Deterministic authored responses and synthetic source transport only; demonstrates information access and evidence handling, not live web research, reasoning superiority or complete economic advantage.

criteria.requirement: Credential, permission, protocol, quota and malformed-output failures
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Execute invalid credentials, consent, protocol, budget, missing usage, malformed response and interrupted stream regressions.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final-source receipt required. Transport fixtures plus actual local model; remote account-specific behavior remains live-unverified.
criteria.historical_scope: Transport fixtures plus actual local model; remote account-specific behavior remains live-unverified.

criteria.requirement: OAuth refusal, expiry, revocation and plan exhaustion
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Validate OIDC signature/claims and refusal/expiry/revocation/quota/account-race fixtures.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final-source receipt required. Contract and cryptographic tests; no real Pro sign-in or revocation completed.
criteria.historical_scope: Contract and cryptographic tests; no real Pro sign-in or revocation completed.

criteria.requirement: Cancellation, persistence, recovery and failed tool execution
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Cancel stale model output; fail unauthorized tools; persist and resume after actual subprocess crash during repair; round-trip browser JSON.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final-source receipt required. No externally executed consequential actions; uncertain upstream requests remain charged/recorded.
criteria.historical_scope: No externally executed consequential actions; uncertain upstream requests remain charged/recorded.

criteria.requirement: Untrusted input, filesystem isolation and secret exclusion
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Reject foreign origin and unsafe files/imported runners; enforce local-only before dispatch; redact fragmented credentials.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final-source Linux fixture execution required. OS first-use tests and credential-free Codex sandbox probes do not validate Windows credential protection or the complete cross-platform security suite.
criteria.historical_scope: Tested Linux private workspace boundary. Windows protection code remains platform-unverified.

criteria.requirement: Archive corruption and identity substitution
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Reject corrupt, traversal, symlink, substituted-source and forged-manifest archive cases.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final-source receipt required. Integrity requires an independently trusted published checksum; self-consistency is not authenticity.
criteria.historical_scope: Integrity requires an independently trusted published checksum; self-consistency is not authenticity.

criteria.requirement: Exact archive inventory, hashes and clean operation
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: package_release.py build/verify then qualify_archive.py on same immutable bytes
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Exact committed package and external digest

criteria.requirement: Bilingual guides, launchers, examples, notices and owner materials
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Checked bilingual documentation links, launcher syntax/help, scoped license and required file inventory.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Exact archive inventory and generated owner handoff required. Platform execution is reported separately in I2; commercial integration approval and listing activation remain separate.
criteria.historical_scope: macOS/Windows launcher execution untested. Commercial integration approval and final listing activation remain separate.

criteria.requirement: Current Squarespace single-file size constraint
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Official public Download-products documentation inspection, 2026-11-09
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: One file under 300 MB; packager conservatively enforces <300000000 bytes; no account activity

criteria.requirement: Linux graphical first use and accessibility checks
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Actual browser, keyboard, responsive layout and export/reopen test
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Observed screenshots and operation receipt

criteria.requirement: macOS and Windows same-archive launcher help and headless first use
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Operate the same source-bound archive on actual hosted macOS and Windows: JavaScript tests, native launcher help, Python loopback startup and headless browser first-use checks.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Matching source/archive PASS receipts from both operating systems required. Excludes the complete Python/security suite, authenticated models, signed installers, Finder/Explorer double-click, Safari and accessibility conformance. Repeated tests are per-platform executions.

criteria.requirement: Machine-readable and human-readable exact-source qualification
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Reconcile this matrix, final report and exact source/archive identity
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Final acceptance evidence
